title: Propagate async span and subscriber context
brief: Async instrumentation scopes context around polling. Span context and subscriber dispatch are separate parts of a composition, especially across spawned work.

choices.choose_when: A future belongs to a particular span
choices.tradeoff: The wrapper enters that span as the future is polled.

choices.choose_when: A future must use an explicit dispatcher
choices.tradeoff: Carries subscriber context; does not choose the intended parent span.
An entered guard held across await can misattribute concurrent work.

claims.statement: The pinned Instrument docs describe entering the span whenever the future is polled. Spawn boundaries require verifying the actual propagated context.
A spawned future carrying both the parent span and subscriber dispatch produces the expected parent ID. A separate unparented control does not acquire that parent.

implementation: Create the intended parent span before moving work; instrument the future and preserve the dispatcher where needed.
unknowns: No blanket inheritance guarantee for all executors or spawn APIs.

evidence.scope: Retained exact-release source or documentation; local runtime assertions are linked separately.
